physicalNotes: Radius 0.613 +/- 0.028 solar radii from Rowe et al. 2014, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of Kepler-398 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014ApJ...784...45R/abstract): 426,464 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Temperature 4493 +/- 100 K from Rowe et al. 2014, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of Kepler-398 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014ApJ...784...45R/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
